gpu_jobs_note: the gate is live: any automation declaring heavy GPU work meets it. No automation declares heavy GPU work yet, so nothing is being refused today.

held_by_aries.line: ARIES 1000 stamenovmartin 325913 systemd-inhibit sleep ARIES Background Mode is on — automations keep running while the display is off block

effect: this machine is already set never to suspend on mains power, so the inhibitor changes nothing while it is plugged in — it matters on battery

classes.name: light
classes.title: Lightweight
classes.description: Reading files, fetching feeds, arithmetic over rows. Costs a fraction of one core for seconds. Always allowed, including while the display is off.
classes.why: always runs, including while the display is off

classes.name: inference_light
classes.title: Lightweight inference
classes.description: A model answering a bounded question — classification, a short summary. Allowed while the display is off; it is not a sustained load.
classes.why: always runs, including while the display is off

classes.name: heavy_cpu
classes.title: Sustained high CPU
classes.description: Work that will hold several cores busy for minutes — indexing, a large local model, a full repository analysis. Blocked while the display is off unless enabled, and budgeted when it is.
classes.why: not enabled for while the display is off

classes.name: heavy_gpu
classes.title: Sustained GPU
classes.description: Work that will hold the GPU busy — local model inference or training. Blocked while the display is off unless enabled, and budgeted when it is.
classes.why: not enabled for while the display is off
